_comment_2: Set 'start_date' to whatever day you want post #1 (day_offset 0) to go live.
_comment_3: Posts release one per day from that date. No cron job needed — blog/index.php does the math.
_comment_4: To delay or skip releases, edit day_offset on individual posts. To re-release: just change start_date.
